texts: Refer adults with persistent synovitis of undetermined cause to a specialist, and refer urgently if the small joints of the hands or feet are affected.
Consider a back-up antibiotic prescription or an immediate antibiotic prescription for women with lower urinary tract infection who are not pregnant.
Offer combination therapy with an oral triptan and a non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug, or an oral triptan and paracetamol, for the acute treatment of migraine.
